posts.title: Trump's Approach
posts.description: Donald Trump's unorthodox approach has baffled many. This article explains that Trump uses confidence to win arguments, even if the facts don't support his position. Trump gave an uncharacteristic commencement address ( video ) in 2025 at the University of Alabama. In it, he listed eleven keys to his success: Do big things when you are young Love what you do Think big Work hard Don't lose your mom
